resources.string: Scan the code with your phone, then choose a picture for %1$s.
Use the arrows to move it, then press OK
This TV doesn\'t let apps choose the Home app. Set it from a computer: see Vibe Launcher\'s README
This build has a different signing key: update it from a computer, with build-and-install.sh
Allow Vibe Launcher to install apps, then choose Update again
This TV doesn\'t let apps install updates
The download didn\'t match the release, so it wasn\'t installed
Clean backdrops and title logos for films and shows.
Popular videos in your country for the YouTube tile.
Your own YouTube feed for the YouTube tile, no key needed.
Backdrops from your own Plex server.
Started as a fork of Gathin23/tv-vibehack. The Outfit typeface is under the SIL Open Font License. Backdrops use the TMDB API but are not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
Scan with your phone to paste the keys
Backdrops use the TMDB API but are not endorsed or certified by TMDB.

Clean backdrops and title logos for the films and shows on your apps\' home screen cards, in place of their own art and stickers. It works without a key, from Stremio\'s free data; TMDB is the official, more reliable source.\n\nFree key: themoviedb.org → Settings → API → personal use.

With SmartTube signed in, the YouTube tile shows videos from your own YouTube feed. No key needed.

Without it, a key shows the most popular videos in your country. Free key: console.cloud.google.com → new project → enable YouTube Data API v3 → Credentials → Create API key.

With neither, it shows trailers of popular films.
Allow Vibe Launcher to install apps, then choose Install SmartTube again

Backdrops from your own Plex server: Continue Watching and recently added.\n\nTo find it: app.plex.tv → open any title → ⋯ → Get Info → View XML, and copy what follows X-Plex-Token= in the address. Keep it private, like a password.
The arrows move the dot: the color around the wheel, paler towards the middle. OK when done.
Makes the remote\'s Home button open Vibe Launcher instead of the TV\'s own home screen, and holding it open the TV\'s Settings. It reads nothing on screen and passes every other key on.
Turn on “%1$s” here so the Home button opens Vibe Launcher.

Vibe Launcher will ask for two permissions next.

TV listings: to show pictures from the cards your apps publish for the home screen.

Location: Android only shows the Wi-Fi network's name to apps with it. Vibe Launcher uses it for that name alone and never looks up where the TV is.

Neither leaves the TV.

This TV doesn't let apps become the Home app, so Vibe Launcher needs an accessibility service to answer the Home button.

It takes the Home button: a press opens Vibe Launcher, a hold opens Settings, and every other key passes on untouched. It also sees when the TV's own home screen comes up, and covers it. It reads nothing on screen, keeps nothing and sends nothing anywhere.

Turn it off any time in Settings > Accessibility.

If you turn on “%1$s”, it also opens Vibe Launcher when the screen turns on, unless you press a key first (it notes only that a key was pressed, not which). And “%2$s” in Settings uses it to open the TV\'s power menu.
For TVs that keep their own home screen: the remote\'s Home button opens Vibe Launcher, and holding it opens the TV\'s Settings.
Next: in the list that opens, choose “%1$s”, turn it on, then press Home.
Settings, tiles, folders, tile pictures and API keys. A backup holds your keys, so keep it private.
Kept in the TV\'s Download folder as vibe-launcher-backup.json, replacing the last one.
Back up or restore with your phone
Scan with your phone to save a backup there or send one back
Settings, tiles, folders and keys are all replaced by the backup\'s, then Home starts again.
Vibe Launcher needs storage access for this
Turn off apps you don\'t use: they stay installed, but can\'t run, fill the home screen or update until you turn them back on. Parts the TV needs to work aren\'t listed.

Vibe Launcher turns apps off through the TV\'s debugging, as a computer would. Turn on USB debugging (ADB debugging or Network debugging on some TVs) in Developer options, then press OK here and allow Vibe Launcher on the TV.
On the TV\'s question, tick Always allow, then choose OK
In Developer options, turn on USB debugging (called ADB debugging or Network debugging on some TVs), then come back here.

Debugging is on, but this TV doesn\'t let apps reach it yet. In Developer options, look for Network debugging or ADB over network and turn it on. If it only has Wireless debugging, Vibe Launcher can\'t use that yet.
Turns back on every app Vibe Launcher turned off.
This TV can\'t keep the key Vibe Launcher needs
Your TV needs this to work properly, so Vibe Launcher won\'t turn it off. This keeps your TV safe.
Turn on Developer options first: in About, press OK on Build seven times, then come back here.
Apps Vibe Launcher turned off before that are on here now: from a backup restored on this TV, or turned back on by an update.
Tested lists of what to turn off, TV by TV, from the Clean Your TV community. Pick the one for your TV, check it, then turn them off.
Lists by the Clean Your TV community (github.com/Gathin23/cleanyourtv), MIT licence, each tested on its TV by the person who made it. The best matches for this TV come first.
The lists couldn\'t be loaded. Check the TV\'s internet connection.
✓ marks what will be turned off; OK changes it. Apps that aren\'t on this TV are left out, and so are parts it needs. What the list\'s maker kept on by choice starts unticked.
When you leave Settings, Vibe Launcher turns the TV\'s debugging off again, and back on by itself the next time it needs it. A computer can\'t reach the TV over ADB while it\'s off.
Turns the TV\'s own home screen off, so the Home button opens Vibe Launcher, with no Home button service needed.
The TV\'s own home screen is turned off and Vibe Launcher becomes Home. If that doesn\'t take, everything is put back at once. Back to the TV\'s own home screen undoes it.
Back to the TV\'s own home screen
This TV didn\'t take it, so its own home screen is back
On this device, a different Home stops casting from working, so Vibe Launcher leaves its own home screen alone.
The TV\'s own animations, as apps and menus open: faster ones make an older TV feel quicker. Needs Settings > Apps to have been allowed once.
Closes the apps running in the background, as the TV does when it runs short.
